text:
alicia: Heads-up — auditors requested a short fieldwork window, prefer mornings. Proposed slots: 2025-05-20 AM and 2025-05-21 AM. Need owners for three deliverables before I lock dates: (A) audit-log backfill artifacts, (B) KMS rotation evidence, (C) HSM attestation smoke. Who can pick these up?

sam: I can take (A) audit-log backfill. Question: should we stage into a separate bucket or write directly to the prod audit bucket? Also need to know target time range for backfill.

maria: I will own (B) KMS rotation evidence. Please DM me the key IDs/aliases and the rotation timeframe to capture. Ill gather get-key-rotation outputs + CloudTrail slices.

devon: I'll do (C) HSM smoke. Need a non-prod HSM replica window and a short-lived service account with RA to the replica. Also want the attestation checklist from security ops.

alicia: Good. @sam can you confirm bucket choice and whether we need to disable any lifecycle jobs? @devon any preference for morning slot on 5/20 vs 5/21?

sam: Prefer staging bucket: s3://audit-fieldwork-staging/2025-05. Keeps prod untouched and easier for auditors to review. Backfill window: 2025-01-01 -> 2025-04-30 unless compliance asks for more. Lifecycle: keep 60-90 days then archive. Cost estimate is low for short hold.

maria: Thanks. I'll prepare a tarball containing: kms-rotation-status.log (aws kms get-key-rotation-status outputs), kms-rotation-cloudtrail.json (filtered CloudTrail events), and an evidence README with commands.

devon: Staging HSM is available mornings. Prefer 5/20 at 07:30 UTC. I'll request infra now for the 07:00-10:00 slot and will schedule the attestation at 07:30 to avoid peak auditor times.

alicia: Another blocker check: will the backfill overlap with prefix TTL jobs or live ingestion in a way that confuses auditors? @sam

sam: Backfill pipeline tags records with metadata `fieldwork_origin=backfill` so auditors can exclude duplicates. We throttle to 500 events/s by default; pipeline can handle bursts but we won't need to. If they want faster, I can add a temporary throttle bump.

maria: For the evidence package, I'll include an evidence matrix CSV mapping control IDs -> artifact filenames per compliance request. Also include short reproduction commands.

devon: HSM plan (brief): run attest script against staging HSM; capture signed digests and export attest log; bundle as hsm-attest-2025-05-20.tar.gz. No key material rotations during smoke.

alicia: Action items & due dates Ill use to confirm calendar: sam: backfill PR + staging path by 2025-05-07; maria: KMS evidence preview by 2025-05-10; devon: confirm HSM window & infra account by 2025-05-06. React with :white_check_mark: if dates work.

sam: :white_check_mark: Will open PR and tag @eng-platform for ACL review.

maria: :white_check_mark: I'll upload preview to secure share and post link.

devon: :white_check_mark: Pinging infra now.

sec-bot: Calendar event created: "SOC2 fieldwork (tentative)" 2025-05-20 07:30-10:00 UTC and 2025-05-21 07:30-10:00 UTC. Organizer: alicia.

alicia: If anyone sees a hard blocker (eg missing logs older than retention or scheduled HSM maintenance) flag it today so I can move the slot.

jon: Small compliance ask: include a simple traceability matrix that maps each artifact to the control narrative. Keep it one CSV.

maria: Will include evidence-matrix.csv inside the tarball.

sam: I'll add a dry-run flag to the backfill tool and post sample output in the PR. Example: `./backfill.sh --start 2025-01-01 --end 2025-04-30 --dry-run`.

devon: Infra confirmed the slot: staging HSM reserved 2025-05-20 07:00-10:00 UTC. I'll schedule the run at 07:30 UTC and post the run log to the thread.

alicia: Great  I'll tentatively book auditors for those mornings and share a single checklist doc with links to the PR, preview, and artifacts. Thanks all. Thread will be used to centralize links and signoffs.

sam: Note: tagging @eng-infra in PR for ACL change and @security-ops for access to the KMS artifacts.

maria: Preview upload: https://secure.share/redwood/kms-evidence-preview-2025-05-10 (creds to be rotated after reviewers confirm).

alicia: Closing loop. If anything changes ping me directly. We'll archive the thread after signoff.
